selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main truth is being explained in this passage?
questions.answer: It explains absolute lordship and shows that Allah alone controls, cares for, and manages the whole universe.

questions.question: What kind of “hand” is described as working everywhere in the universe?
questions.answer: A hidden hand that acts with wisdom and mercy.

questions.question: What does “absolute” add to the idea of lordship here?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah’s rule is total, unlimited, and not shared.

questions.question: What does the regular care of creation show about the One behind it?
questions.answer: It shows that the One behind it has real and complete lordship.

questions.question: What does the passage say are gathered together in small, living things?
questions.answer: The important aims of lordship are gathered together in them.

questions.question: Why does complete lordship rule out partners?
questions.answer: Because its goals can only be achieved if all authority belongs to one Lord.

questions.question: How would turning people toward causes instead of Allah oppose this truth?
questions.answer: It would pull aware beings away from Allah and from the purposes He intended.

questions.question: What does it mean that this guidance is found even in the Qur’an’s letters and their forms?
questions.answer: It means the message of tawhid is deeply woven throughout the Qur’an.

questions.question: How do the beginning and ending of the passage connect?
questions.answer: It begins with signs of care in the universe and ends by showing that the Qur’an confirms that those signs lead to tawhid.

questions.question: Which title is given to the second truth in the passage?
questions.answer: It is called absolute dominicality, meaning Allah’s complete lordship.

questions.question: What does the passage say this care is an outflow or reflection of?
questions.answer: It is a reflection of Allah’s complete lordship.

questions.question: What two qualities describe the way this rule appears?
questions.answer: It appears with wisdom and mercy.

questions.question: Why is the same kind of care appearing everywhere important?
questions.answer: It shows a single source of control rather than many separate rulers.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from that kind of care?
questions.answer: It concludes that there is one true Lord whose rule is complete.

questions.question: According to the passage, what would happen if even the smallest thing were linked to a partner besides Allah?
questions.answer: The purposes of lordship would be blocked and those goals would be damaged.

questions.question: What role does the Qur’an play at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It serves as a steady guide that directs people to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What final support is brought from the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The passage says the Qur’an constantly points people to Allah’s transcendence and unity.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an described in relation to Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: It is described as a constant guide leading people to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What evidence from the universe is used first in this passage?
questions.answer: The first evidence is the wise and merciful care seen everywhere in creation.

questions.question: Where does the passage say this rule can be noticed most clearly?
questions.answer: It can be noticed throughout the universe, especially in living beings.

questions.question: What example does the passage give special attention to within creation?
questions.answer: It especially points to living things and how they grow and are cared for.

questions.question: What makes this care more than ordinary or random?
questions.answer: It is full of wisdom, mercy, and order.

questions.question: Where are those goals especially gathered and shown?
questions.answer: They are focused in individual things and in living beings.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does absolute lordship view that mistake?
questions.answer: It rejects it completely because it clashes with the truth of Allah’s rule.
